from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ContractLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Contract liability information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name, as written in the document")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities/trading code if provided")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Financial report period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    contract_liability_balance: float | None = Field(description="Contract liability balance amount in yuan")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt mentioning the contract liability amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    contract_liability_records: list[ContractLiabilityRecord]
